This is the original mobile version of Ex Astris, go play the main game if you want

🛸 Welcome to Ex Astris, a space nation simulator, strategy, and galactic map roleplay game!
The game features an actual economy and military system, this is NOT a map painting experience. Players can colonize planets throughout the galaxy, building on planets to harvest minerals, credits, food, and other resources. The map is expansive and can hold dozens of empires per server, including more than 8000 randomly generated star systems with up 5 planets each.
